observed_source_gap.finding: InferenceReceipt/v3 binds the route-level model_lanes tuple and loader-bound output identity but does not bind one concrete output-producing model lane or GRID10 cell. A multi-lane route therefore cannot prove which cell produced a particular receipt output.
observed_source_gap.impact: A J-Space/GWT training trace that assigns that output to one multi-lane GRID10 cell would overclaim causal provenance.

hypothesis: A minimal fail-closed bridge can safely create causally unambiguous J-Space runtime evidence from the existing v3 receipt only when the GRID10 plan and inference receipt each contain exactly one model lane/cell.
counterhypothesis: The route-level model_lanes tuple in InferenceReceipt/v3 is sufficient to identify the output-producing cell even when multiple lanes are present.

unusual_experiment.name: MULTILANE_CROSS_CELL_OUTPUT_ASSIGNMENT_AMBIGUITY
unusual_experiment.setup: Construct one receipt information-shape with model_lanes=[ANALYZE,CRITIC] and one GRID10 shape with MODEL:ANALYZE at cell-02 and MODEL:CRITIC at cell-03; ask which cell is uniquely identified as output producer using only v3 lane-set information.
unusual_experiment.scope_limit: Synthetic component discriminator only. It is not exact EntityOS/HCU runtime execution, model execution, J-Space causality evidence, or whole-product acceptance.

next_exact_gate: Execute the new focused regressions on an actually-started authorized isolated executor, then feed the binding identity into the selected J-Space training-trace path. For multi-lane GRID10, evolve the canonical single inference producer to a version that binds one concrete output-producing lane/cell before admitting causal training traces.
